fix: Make Choose and Back a fixed footer outside the panel's scroll region (flex column, footer flex: none, panel max-height 100dvh minus safe areas); landscape: two columns, the 4x3 team grid on the left, details, stats and both buttons on the right; portrait: cap the tub preview height so panel plus footer fit 844 px. Test: at 844x390 and 390x844, both buttons fully inside the viewport, Handling and Water rows unclipped, and the tub's wheels clear of the panel. Gain split +0.75 mobile, +0.25 ui, +0.25 typography. Merges G-mobile-selector; severity 4 (regression from a known-good layout).

Build each rail segment from consecutive post positions (yaw from the post-to-post vector, length equal to post spacing), keep runs at least 0.3 m on the sidewalk side of the curb, end every run on a post, and skip segments whose footprint hits a spectator or lamp. In the same prop pass, run a continuous 1x1 core through each pine's full height and replace the tan pine tint with a green. Test: in R01, R03, R05, R13 and R15 no rail pixel lies road-side of the curb line and every rail ends at a post; in R08, column x722-730 shows no sky between tiers. Gain split +0.5 scenery, +0.25 readability.

Anchor the cone about 0.3 m above the player captain's hat, cap its on-screen width at 28 CSS px, keep it a camera-facing upright billboard (no yaw skew), and hide it during the countdown; if its screen box overlaps a rival crew, drop it to hat height or switch to a team-colour ground ring under the player's tub. Test: in desktop R03 and R04 and mobile R03 and R04 the tip is within 20 CSS px of the player captain's hat and overlaps no rival; in strips/high/R14 frames 3-8 it stays a symmetric upright triangle; no overlap with READY in R03. Gain split +0.5 readability, +0.25 mobile.

Half-res SSAO or GTAO on High and baked vertex AO on building bases and props on Medium and Low; a soft contact-shadow decal under each boot and wheel; at dusk and sunset, lamp light that pools on the road (point lights on High, projected light decals on Low) and about 30% more hemisphere fill. Test: road at the crew's toes in crops/high/R03-kart_5 at most 0.8x open road (now 88.5 vs 91.6); in R07 road within 3 m of a lit lamp at least 1.3x road between lamps; R11 pack-box RMS luminance deviation from road at least 35 (now about 22). These replace the crew/road >= 2.0 test, which black-uniformed teams fail at noon. Gain split +1.0 lighting, +0.25 readability. Merges G-contact-lighting.

Replace the per-pixel screen-door fade with alpha-to-coverage under MSAA (or a stable 4x4 Bayer pattern plus a 1-px blur on the faded layer), keep tree trunks at least 9 m from the racing line so canopies rarely enter the fade band, and fade rivals only where they overlap the player's tub. Test: mean |dx| of L at most 3.0 in R11 x950-1250,y150-400 (now 11.4), R15 x0-140,y190-330 (now 12.9) and R08 x0-250,y60-250 (now 7.7). Gain split +0.5 readability, +0.25 materials, +0.25 scenery.

Snap the Arlington's navy window panels to the painted window grid, or remove the painted windows under them; weld road-strip vertices at centrelines and junctions and exclude road meshes from the seam-darkening term. Test: in R06 each panel covers exactly one painted window with no painted frame beside it; in R08 and R13 no dark line more than 15 L below the road and longer than 20 px outside painted markings.

Replace flat discs with smaller, partly transparent 1x1 round-plate and stud particles that tumble under gravity, with screen coverage over the player's tub capped at about 30%; emit white steam plates while hot steam charges; +4 degree FOV kick and 80 ms shake on slide release and hits; tilt the tub-water plane with lateral acceleration; on rail contact, push the tub back instead of passing through. Test: steam visible in R14 frames 3-8, water plane tilted in at least 3 frames, captain visible in R15 frames 3-6, no rail through the tub or crew in R14 frame 8.

Stand both striped judges on the road side of the booth, facing traffic, with clipboards raised, and replace the flat rectangular flag board with a feather-flag shape (curved top, tapered free edge) set beside them. Test: both judges fully visible, unoccluded by booth or flag, in high/desktop/R16 and strips/high/R16 frames 1-3. Gain split +0.25 authenticity, +0.25 readability.

Replace the blurred photographic panorama and pale band with 2-3 layers of brick-stepped green ridgelines, extend the terrain to meet them, and set the fog colour to the horizon sky; place the Arlington (or a far LOD of it) so it terminates the Central Avenue sightline. Test: in R06 no horizon band brighter than both neighbours (now L 183 vs 150 hills and 144 grass); the Arlington visible at the end of the road in R04 and R14. Gain split +0.5 authenticity, +0.25 scenery, +0.25 lighting. Merges G-world-edge.

R09: a stepped grey brick Goat Rock outcrop at the roadside and a translucent blue water ford across the road with spray (water, not the tan tiles added this loop); R17: a fountain centrepiece, benches and trees in Hill Wheatley Plaza; R13: one identifying Bridge Street feature; one hero prop per mountain course (R08, R10, R11, R12). Test: each named landmark visible in its capture. Gain split +0.5 authenticity, +0.25 scenery.

Add a hair or hat-back print per team; re-bake torso prints at 512 px or more per face (or SDF decals); give each team its own back motif instead of the shared X; build the tub body from stacked curved-slope bricks with visible seams; add wheel tread and hub detail; cap specular and rim on dark albedo (the leg face is sun-specular, not only rim). Faces already vary and part joins already exist, so those are out of scope. Test: R03-player-rear shows head-back prints and print edges ramp 4 px or less at 2x; the R04-kart_3 raised leg is at most 1.6x the shaded leg's luminance (now (124,128,126)).
